question: According to the Ministry of Commerce and Industry (2018-19), which state of India is the largest producer of Rubber?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** is the largest producer of rubber in India, as per the **Ministry of Commerce and Industry** for the year 2018-19.
 
• The state's climatic conditions are highly suitable for rubber cultivation, making it the leading contributor to the country's rubber production.
 
• Rubber plantations in Kerala are predominantly found in the districts of Kottayam, Kollam, and Ernakulam.
 
• The state contributes more than **90% of the total rubber production** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Rubber is a critical industrial raw material and is used in various products, including tyres, footwear, and industrial goods.
 
• The **Rubber Board of India**, headquartered in **Kottayam, Kerala,** is responsible for the development of the rubber industry in the country.
 
• India is among the top producers of natural rubber in the world, with Kerala playing a pivotal role in this achievement.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**__**Maharashtra**__

__
 
• Maharashtra is the** largest producer of grapes** in India.
 
• The state greatly contributes to the nation’s sugarcane yield.
 
• It is a significant cotton producer, particularly in the **Vidarbha region.**
 
• Maharashtra is also known for its horticultural crops like** oranges, pomegranates**, and bananas.

**Gujarat**__

__
 
• Gujarat is the** largest producer of cotton** in India.
 
• The state leads in groundnut production.
 
• Gujarat has a strong** dairy industry**, making it one of the top milk producers in the country.
 
• The state is the largest producer of** castor seeds** in India.

**Uttar Pradesh**__

 
• Uttar Pradesh is the** largest producer of sugarcane** in India.
 
• The state is a major contributor to the country’s wheat production.
 
• Uttar Pradesh significantly produces **paddy (rice)**.
 
• The state is famous for its **Dasheri mangoes.**
